General queries

Frequently asked questions

What is Sanctify?
Sanctify is an award-winning digital marketing and advertising agency founded in Goa in 2012. Our flagship agency is Sanctify Goa (sanctify.in), and we also run a small network of supporting platforms — the Sanctify.biz local-SEO engine, Sanctify Hostings (sanctify.co.in) and the Goa Guru local portal — offering web design, SEO, advertising, social media and branding.
What services does Sanctify offer?
Sanctify offers digital marketing, search engine optimization (SEO), Google Ads and paid advertising, social media marketing, web design and development, content marketing, branding and creative, and web hosting.
Where is Sanctify based and which areas does it serve?
Sanctify is headquartered in Vasco-da-Gama, Goa, India, and serves businesses across North and South Goa and beyond, including Panjim, Calangute, Mapusa, Margao and other towns.
How experienced is Sanctify?
Sanctify has 13+ years of experience (since 2012), has grown 100+ brands, and holds a 4.8/5 rating across 128 client reviews.
How do I get in touch with Sanctify?
You can reach Sanctify by phone at +91-9923352923, on WhatsApp, or by email at business@sanctify.biz. The team responds within one working day.
